name: DP World — Global Port Empire
description: DP World operates 82 terminals in 40+ countries. Revenue $18.9B. Dubai sovereign entity and backbone of UAE's global logistics reach.

name: ADNOC — Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
description: ADNOC is the world's 12th largest oil company, producing ~4M bbl/day. Expanding into LNG, petrochemicals, and hydrogen. State-owned by Abu Dhabi.

name: Mubadala Investment Company
description: Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund with $300B+ AUM. Major investments in aerospace, defense, semiconductors, and AI. Strategic bridge between East and West.

name: ADIA — Abu Dhabi Investment Authority
description: World's 3rd largest sovereign wealth fund with ~$990B in assets. Silent but massive global investor across real estate, infrastructure, and equities.

name: Emirates Airlines
description: World's largest international airline by revenue passenger-kilometers. Dubai hub connects 150+ cities. Strategic aviation reach and soft power projection.

name: EDGE Group
description: UAE defense and technology conglomerate, ranked among top 25 global defense companies. Produces drones, munitions, cyber tools, and autonomous systems.

name: Masdar — Clean Energy
description: Abu Dhabi's renewable energy company with 20GW+ capacity across 40 countries. Masdar City is a showcase for sustainable urban development and UAE's energy transition play.

name: AD Ports Group
description: Abu Dhabi's port operator managing Khalifa Port, Zayed Port, and expanding into East Africa and Central Asia. Key node in IMEC corridor logistics.

name: Etihad Rail
description: UAE national railway linking Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and GCC neighbors. Critical land-based link for IMEC corridor freight transit through the Arabian Peninsula.
tag: UAE INFRASTRUCTURE — NATIONAL RAIL / IMEC LINK

name: G42
description: Abu Dhabi AI and cloud computing company. Subject of intense US-China competition — forced to divest Chinese ties under US pressure. Microsoft invested $1.5B.
tag: UAE TECH — AI COMPANY / US-CHINA FLASHPOINT

name: Abu Dhabi Ship Building (ADSB)
description: UAE's only naval shipbuilder, constructing corvettes, patrol vessels, and landing craft for UAE Navy and export. Part of EDGE Group ecosystem.

name: TAQA — Abu Dhabi National Energy
description: State-owned power and water utility operating across 11 countries with 18GW capacity. Critical infrastructure provider in UAE, Ghana, India, and North America.
tag: UAE ENERGY — POWER & WATER ACROSS 11 COUNTRIES

name: BlackRock
description: World's largest asset manager with $10T+ AUM. Led consortium to acquire Hutchison port assets globally. Financial infrastructure arm of US strategic reach.
tag: US FINANCE — $10T ASSET MANAGER / PORT ACQUISITIONS

name: Lockheed Martin
description: World's largest defense contractor. Produces F-35, THAAD, Aegis systems. Revenue ~$67B. Backbone of US and allied military capability globally.
tag: US DEFENSE — WORLD'S LARGEST DEFENSE CONTRACTOR

name: Raytheon / RTX
description: Produces Patriot missiles, Tomahawk cruise missiles, advanced radars, and satellite systems. Revenue ~$69B. Critical to US and allied air defense architecture.
tag: US DEFENSE — MISSILES, RADARS, AIR DEFENSE

name: Palantir Technologies
description: Intelligence and data analytics platform used by CIA, DOD, and allied governments. Gotham and Foundry platforms underpin battlefield and intelligence analysis.

name: SpaceX / Starlink
description: SpaceX dominates global launch market. Starlink provides satellite internet to 70+ countries and is critical wartime communications infrastructure (used in Ukraine).
tag: US TECH — SPACE & SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS DOMINANCE

name: Chevron
description: Major global integrated oil company with operations in the Permian Basin, Gulf of Mexico, Kazakhstan, and Eastern Mediterranean. Revenue ~$200B.
tag: US ENERGY — MAJOR GLOBAL OIL & GAS

name: ExxonMobil
description: World's largest non-state oil company. Dominates Permian Basin, Guyana deepwater, and global LNG. Revenue ~$340B. Anchor of US energy independence strategy.
tag: US ENERGY — WORLD'S LARGEST NON-STATE OIL COMPANY

name: Bechtel Corporation
description: America's largest private construction company. Builds pipelines, LNG terminals, rail, and military bases globally. Key IMEC corridor infrastructure partner.

name: CENTCOM — US Central Command
description: US military command responsible for the Middle East, Central Asia, and East Africa. Oversees 20 countries and all US military operations in the IMEC/BRI theater.
tag: US DEFENSE — MIDDLE EAST MILITARY COMMAND

name: NSA — National Security Agency
description: US signals intelligence agency at Fort Meade. Intercepts global communications, breaks encryption, and conducts cyber operations. Largest intelligence agency by budget.

name: CIA — Central Intelligence Agency
description: America's primary human intelligence agency headquartered in Langley, VA. Conducts covert operations, regime influence, and geopolitical analysis globally.
tag: US INTELLIGENCE — HUMAN INTELLIGENCE / COVERT OPS

name: Goldman Sachs
description: Global investment bank and financial infrastructure pillar. Underwrites sovereign debt, advises on M&A, and structures corridor financing across emerging markets.

name: NSO Group — Pegasus Spyware
description: Creator of Pegasus spyware, capable of zero-click phone infiltration. Used by 40+ governments. Israel's most controversial tech export and intelligence leverage tool.

name: Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI)
description: Israel's largest defense company. Produces satellites, missiles, drones (Heron), and the Arrow missile defense system. Revenue ~$5.5B. State-owned.

name: Elbit Systems
description: Israel's largest publicly traded defense company. Produces drones, helmets, EW systems, and border surveillance. Exports to 50+ countries.

name: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems
description: Developer of Iron Dome, David's Sling, and Spike missiles. State-owned. Israel's shield against rocket and missile threats. Revenue ~$3B.
tag: ISRAEL DEFENSE — IRON DOME / DAVID'S SLING

name: Intel Israel — Kiryat Gat Fab
description: Intel's largest fab outside the US. Israel's biggest private employer. Produces advanced chips and is Israel's top exporter. $25B new fab investment announced.

name: Mossad
description: Israel's national intelligence agency responsible for overseas operations, covert action, and counterterrorism. One of the world's most effective intelligence services.

name: Unit 8200
description: IDF signals intelligence unit, equivalent to NSA. Feeds Israel's cyber-surveillance ecosystem. Alumni founded NSO, Check Point, Waze, and dozens of tech startups.

name: Israel Ports — Haifa & Ashdod
description: Israel's two main commercial ports. Haifa is contested — China's SIPG operates a terminal 1.8km from the Israeli navy base. Critical IMEC corridor endpoint.

name: Leviathan Gas Field
description: Largest deepwater gas field in the Eastern Mediterranean. 22 TCF reserves. Operated by Chevron. Gives Israel energy independence and export leverage to Egypt and Jordan.

name: Adani Haifa Port (India-Israel Joint)
description: Adani Ports (India) holds 70% with Gadot (Israel) 30% of Haifa's old port. Represents India's strategic foothold on the Mediterranean and IMEC's western anchor.

name: Zangezur Copper-Molybdenum Combine
description: Armenia's largest industrial enterprise and one of the world's top copper-molybdenum mines. Located in Kajaran, Syunik province — directly on the contested Zangezur corridor route.
tag: ARMENIA RESOURCE — STRATEGIC MINERALS / CORRIDOR FLASHPOINT

name: Metsamor Nuclear Power Plant
description: The only nuclear power plant in the South Caucasus. Provides ~40% of Armenia's electricity. Soviet-era VVER-440 reactor. Seismically controversial but strategically essential.
tag: ARMENIA ENERGY — SOUTH CAUCASUS NUCLEAR PLANT

name: South Caucasus Pipeline Proximity
description: Armenia lacks direct pipeline access but its geography borders the BTC and South Caucasus Pipeline routes through Georgia and Azerbaijan. Potential transit role if geopolitics shift.

name: Armenian IT Sector — Yerevan Tech Hub
description: Armenia's fastest-growing sector with 1,000+ tech companies in Yerevan. Diaspora-connected to Silicon Valley. Growing defense-tech applications and cybersecurity capabilities.
tag: ARMENIA TECH — YEREVAN SOFTWARE & CYBER HUB

name: Lachin Corridor (Lost 2023)
description: Former lifeline connecting Armenia to Nagorno-Karabakh. Blockaded by Azerbaijan in Dec 2022, fully lost after Sept 2023 ethnic cleansing. Symbol of Armenian strategic collapse.

name: COSCO Shipping HQ
description: World's largest shipping conglomerate operating 370+ ports globally. Pentagon-blacklisted as a Chinese military company. Backbone of BRI maritime logistics.
tag: CHINA CORPORATE — GLOBAL PORT OPERATOR / PENTAGON-BLACKLISTED

name: China Merchants Group HQ
description: State-owned conglomerate spanning ports, shipping, finance, and real estate. Operates ports in 36 countries including Djibouti, Sri Lanka, and Brazil. Key BRI infrastructure arm.
tag: CHINA CORPORATE — PORTS, SHIPPING & FINANCE CONGLOMERATE

name: Huawei HQ
description: World's largest telecoms equipment maker. US-sanctioned since 2019. Builds 5G networks across 170+ countries. Washington sees it as China's digital BRI backbone.

name: CNNC — China National Nuclear Corporation
description: China's primary nuclear weapons and civilian nuclear energy corporation. Builds Hualong One reactors for export to Pakistan, Argentina, and the Middle East.
tag: CHINA DEFENSE — NUCLEAR WEAPONS & CIVILIAN NUCLEAR EXPORTS

name: CNPC / PetroChina HQ
description: China's largest oil and gas company and world's 4th largest by revenue. Operations across Central Asia, Middle East, Africa, and South America. State-owned energy giant.
tag: CHINA ENERGY — LARGEST NATIONAL OIL COMPANY

name: Sinopec HQ
description: World's largest oil refinery operator by throughput. Revenue ~$470B. Dominates China's downstream petrochemical sector and expanding globally into LNG and hydrogen.
tag: CHINA ENERGY — WORLD'S LARGEST REFINERY OPERATOR

name: BeiDou Ground Control Center
description: Ground control for BeiDou, China's rival to GPS with 45 satellites providing global coverage. Used by 120+ countries. Eliminates Chinese military dependence on US GPS.
tag: CHINA TECH — GPS RIVAL / GLOBAL SATELLITE NAV

name: Three Gorges Dam
description: World's largest hydroelectric power station at 22.5 GW capacity. Powers central China's industrial base. Also a critical national vulnerability if struck.
tag: CHINA ENERGY — WORLD'S LARGEST HYDROELECTRIC DAM

name: Beidaihe Leadership Compound
description: Seaside resort where CCP leadership holds secretive annual summer meetings. Major policy decisions and succession planning happen here. China's Camp David equivalent.
tag: CHINA GOVERNANCE — CCP SUMMER LEADERSHIP COMPOUND

name: CATL HQ
description: World's largest EV battery manufacturer with 37% global market share. Supplies Tesla, BMW, Mercedes. Controls critical lithium-ion supply chain chokepoint.
tag: CHINA TECH — WORLD'S LARGEST EV BATTERY MAKER

name: DJI HQ
description: Controls 70%+ of global consumer and commercial drone market. Used by militaries worldwide including in Ukraine. US banned from government use, yet near-impossible to replace.

name: Tsinghua Unigroup / YMTC
description: China's flagship memory chip maker and semiconductor independence push. US-sanctioned. YMTC's 3D NAND flash threatens Western chip dominance. Centerpiece of chip war.

name: Gazprom HQ
description: World's largest natural gas company. Supplies 40% of Europe's gas (pre-2022). Nord Stream pipelines sabotaged 2022. Revenue weaponized as geopolitical lever.
tag: RUSSIA ENERGY — WORLD'S LARGEST GAS COMPANY

name: Rosneft HQ
description: Russia's largest oil company producing ~4M bbl/day. CEO Igor Sechin is Putin's closest energy ally. Sanctioned by the West but selling to India and China at discount.
tag: RUSSIA ENERGY — LARGEST OIL COMPANY / SANCTIONED

name: Rosatom HQ
description: Russia's state nuclear corporation managing both nuclear weapons arsenal and civilian nuclear exports. Builds reactors in Turkey, Egypt, India, Bangladesh, and Hungary. Unsanctioned leverage tool.
tag: RUSSIA DEFENSE — NUCLEAR WEAPONS & REACTOR EXPORTS

name: Almaz-Antey HQ
description: Manufacturer of S-400 and S-300 air defense systems exported globally. Turkey's S-400 purchase triggered US sanctions and NATO rift. Russia's top defense revenue earner.
tag: RUSSIA DEFENSE — S-400 AIR DEFENSE SYSTEMS

name: Novatek HQ
description: Russia's largest private gas producer and Arctic LNG pioneer. Yamal LNG and Arctic LNG 2 projects supply Asia. Sanctions slowed but didn't stop expansion.

name: Wagner Group / Africa Corps
description: Russian paramilitary force operating across Africa (Mali, Libya, Sudan, CAR, Sahel) and formerly Syria/Ukraine. Rebranded as Africa Corps after Prigozhin's death. Secures mines and regimes.

name: Roscosmos / Baikonur Cosmodrome
description: Russia's primary space launch facility, leased from Kazakhstan. Launched first human in space. Still launches Soyuz missions and military satellites despite declining competitiveness.

name: Nornickel HQ
description: World's largest producer of nickel and palladium, critical for EV batteries and catalytic converters. Norilsk Arctic operations. Unsanctioned due to Western supply dependency.
tag: RUSSIA CORPORATE — WORLD'S LARGEST NICKEL/PALLADIUM PRODUCER

name: RT (Russia Today) HQ
description: State-funded media network broadcasting in 100+ countries. Designated foreign agent by US. Primary tool of Russian information warfare and narrative shaping globally.

name: Kalashnikov Concern
description: Manufacturer of the AK-47 and its variants — the most produced firearm in history with 100M+ units worldwide. Also produces drones, boats, and guided munitions.

name: Saudi Aramco HQ
description: World's most valuable company and largest oil producer at 12M+ bbl/day. Revenue ~$535B. Controls world's largest proven oil reserves. OPEC's swing producer.
tag: SAUDI ENERGY — WORLD'S MOST VALUABLE COMPANY

name: PIF — Public Investment Fund
description: Saudi sovereign wealth fund with $930B+ AUM. Vehicle for Vision 2030 diversification. Investments in gaming, sports, tech, and megaprojects. MBS's primary economic tool.

name: NEOM
description: $500B futuristic megacity on the Red Sea coast near Suez. Includes The Line (170km mirror-walled city), Oxagon (floating industrial city), and Trojena (ski resort). Vision 2030 flagship.

name: KACST — King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology
description: Saudi national research and development center. Satellite programs, nuclear research, advanced materials, and military technology. Key to Saudi defense tech independence ambitions.
tag: SAUDI TECH — NATIONAL DEFENSE R&D CENTER

name: SAMI — Saudi Arabian Military Industries
description: PIF-owned defense manufacturing company. Goal: localize 50% of Saudi military spending by 2030. Joint ventures with Lockheed Martin, BAE Systems, and Boeing.

name: SABIC HQ
description: World's 4th largest petrochemicals company. 70% owned by Saudi Aramco. Revenue ~$40B. Produces plastics, fertilizers, and specialty chemicals exported globally.

name: Yanbu Industrial City
description: Massive petrochemical and refining complex on the Red Sea coast. East-West pipeline terminus. Strategic bypass of Strait of Hormuz for Saudi oil exports.

name: Red Sea Global / The Line
description: Red Sea Global develops luxury tourism along Saudi's west coast. The Line — a 170km linear city — is the most ambitious and controversial element of NEOM. Scale reduced but still under construction.

name: ISRO / Sriharikota Launch Center
description: India's primary space launch facility. ISRO achieved Mars orbit on first attempt at fraction of NASA cost. Launched Chandrayaan-3 moon lander 2023. Growing launch market competitor.
tag: INDIA TECH — SPACE LAUNCH / LOW-COST LEADER

name: Reliance Industries HQ
description: India's largest private company. Owns Jamnagar — world's largest oil refinery. Jio telecoms has 450M+ subscribers. Mukesh Ambani is Asia's richest person. Revenue ~$100B.
tag: INDIA CORPORATE — REFINING, TELECOMS & RETAIL EMPIRE

name: Tata Group HQ
description: India's oldest and most diversified conglomerate. Steel, defense (fighter jets), autos (Jaguar Land Rover), tech (TCS), and airlines. Revenue ~$150B. National industrial champion.
tag: INDIA CORPORATE — STEEL, DEFENSE, TECH CONGLOMERATE

name: DRDO HQ
description: India's defense R&D organization with 52 labs. Develops BrahMos missiles (with Russia), Agni ICBMs, and anti-satellite weapons. 30,000+ scientists.

name: HAL HQ
description: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited — India's state-owned aerospace and defense manufacturer. Produces Tejas fighter, ALH helicopter, and license-builds Su-30MKI. Revenue ~$6B.

name: Adani Group HQ
description: India's largest port operator (Mundra, Haifa) and fast-growing energy/infrastructure conglomerate. Gautam Adani pivotal to India's IMEC corridor strategy. Acquired Haifa Port.
tag: INDIA INFRASTRUCTURE — PORTS & ENERGY / IMEC PLAYER

name: BARC — Bhabha Atomic Research Centre
description: India's primary nuclear research facility. Developed India's nuclear weapons tested in 1974 and 1998. Also runs civilian reactor program and thorium fuel cycle research.

name: Bangalore Tech Corridor (Infosys / Wipro / TCS)
description: India's Silicon Valley. Infosys, Wipro, TCS and 400+ MNCs employ millions. $250B+ IT export industry. Global back-office of Western corporations and digital service backbone.

name: Baykar HQ
description: Creator of TB2 Bayraktar drone that changed modern warfare in Libya, Nagorno-Karabakh, and Ukraine. Led by Erdogan's son-in-law Selcuk Bayraktar. Now developing KIZILELMA jet drone.
tag: TURKEY DEFENSE — TB2 DRONE / CHANGED MODERN WARFARE

name: TAI — Turkish Aerospace Industries
description: Developing KAAN 5th-gen stealth fighter jet after Turkey was ejected from F-35 program. Also produces Anka drones and Hurjet trainer. Turkey's aerospace independence play.
tag: TURKEY DEFENSE — KAAN FIGHTER JET / AEROSPACE

name: ASELSAN HQ
description: Turkey's largest defense electronics company. Produces radars, EW systems, comms, and electro-optics. Revenue ~$3B. Backbone of Turkey's indigenous defense ecosystem.

name: Istanbul Canal (Planned)
description: Proposed 45km canal bypassing the Bosporus Strait. Would let Turkey control passage outside Montreux Convention limits. Estimated $15B cost. Geopolitically explosive if built.

name: Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant (Rosatom)
description: Turkey's first nuclear plant, built and owned by Russia's Rosatom under build-own-operate model. Creates long-term Turkish energy dependence on Moscow despite NATO membership.
tag: TURKEY ENERGY — ROSATOM-BUILT NUCLEAR / RUSSIA DEPENDENCE

name: TPAO — Turkish Petroleum
description: Turkey's state oil company aggressively exploring East Mediterranean and Black Sea gas. Discovered 540 BCM Sakarya gas field in 2020. Contested drilling in Cyprus EEZ heightens tensions.
tag: TURKEY ENERGY — EAST MED GAS EXPLORATION

name: BAE Systems HQ
description: Europe's largest and world's 7th largest defense company. Revenue ~$27B. Builds submarines, fighter jets (Tempest), and warships. AUKUS nuclear submarine partner.
tag: UK DEFENSE — EUROPE'S LARGEST DEFENSE COMPANY

name: GCHQ
description: UK's signals intelligence agency and Five Eyes partner. Intercepts global communications, conducts cyber operations, and taps undersea cables. Britain's most valuable intelligence asset.
tag: UK INTELLIGENCE — SIGNALS INTELLIGENCE / FIVE EYES

name: Rolls-Royce (Defence), Derby
description: Builds nuclear reactors for Royal Navy submarines and developing small modular reactors. Powers UK's Trident deterrent and AUKUS submarine program. Critical sovereign capability.

name: BP HQ
description: Global oil and gas major operating in 65+ countries. Revenue ~$200B. Major presence in Caspian (BTC pipeline), Gulf of Mexico, and North Sea. Divested 20% Rosneft stake post-2022.
tag: UK ENERGY — GLOBAL OIL & GAS MAJOR

name: Lloyd's of London
description: World's leading maritime insurance market. Insures 25%+ of global shipping. Can effectively block vessels from trading by withdrawing coverage. Invisible chokepoint on global trade.
tag: UK FINANCE — MARITIME INSURANCE / INVISIBLE TRADE CHOKEPOINT

name: ARM Holdings
description: Designs chip architectures used in 99% of smartphones and increasingly in data centers and AI. SoftBank-owned, Nasdaq-listed. UK's most strategically important tech company.
tag: UK TECH — CHIP DESIGNS IN 99% OF SMARTPHONES
